summary: Iteration 5 testing: /api/videos CRUD backend (11 pytest tests, all passed), UI end-to-end of Vídeos module (create with YouTube embed, component tags, filters, edit, delete), BaseDados reaction-training summary (Rodrigo Prazeres shows only 'Melhor resultado' 412 ms / 'Resultado médio' 665 ms; Daniel Osuji shows empty state), navigation (nav-vídeos present, Caderno removed, /caderno redirects to /registo). Auth playbook spot-checks: bcrypt $2b$ hash, httpOnly cookies, explicit CORS origin with credentials. All test data cleaned (videos collection = 0).

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout: 6 consecutive wrong-password attempts all return 401 and the correct password still succeeds immediately after. Playbook expects lockout after 5 failures.
Returns 200 {ok:true} even for a non-existent (valid ObjectId) id — no 404, so client cannot detect stale deletes.
No validation of title/url (empty strings accepted) and no URL format validation; only frontend guards it.

issues: Uses native browser date input (input type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar/date-picker component — inconsistent with the rest of the design system (pre-existing, not part of this iteration)

action_items: Optional: add brute-force lockout (5 failed logins) per auth playbook
Optional: return 404 on DELETE /api/videos/{id} when id does not exist
Optional: guard BaseDados reaction summary against sessions with all-falsy best_ms (Math.min(...[]) would render 'Infinity ms')
critical_code_review_comments: BaseDados.js:258 — Math.min(...training.map(t => t.best_ms).filter(Boolean)) yields Infinity if every session lacks best_ms; add a fallback ('—').
Videos.js remove() has no try/catch: a failing DELETE shows the success toast path only after the await throws (unhandled promise rejection); wrap in try/catch like save().
server.py VideoIn has no field constraints (min_length on title/url); backend accepts empty payload values.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_ videos via API and UI; videos collection verified empty (0 docs) at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reaction training data lives at GET /api/goalkeepers/{id}/training (not /training-sessions). Only Rodrigo Prazeres has sessions. Nav testids are accent-aware (nav-vídeos); wait for [data-testid='logout-btn'] before querying nav, otherwise selectors can miss during initial render. Video component testids use lowercased/hyphenated PT labels (vcomp-velocidade-de-reação, vfilter-tático).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects reproduced this iteration. Two initial test 'failures' were assertion artifacts (CSS text-transform: uppercase makes inner_text uppercase, and a nav assertion executed before layout render), not app bugs.
